key_finding.title: Current reproduction invalidated the historical Fence Bar promotion claim
key_finding.summary: The historical Fence Bar research artifact reported +0.80% at 5bps and 60% pass rate, but the current implementation reproduces -0.15%, 40% of 15 volatility-eligible windows passing, and 34 trades over the same 94-window period. The refactored backtester matches the actual committed pre-refactor class on identical data; the discrepancy is between the historical artifact and current code/data state. Fence Bar is not currently promoted. The three new hypotheses (VWAP Magnet, First Pullback, Fakeout Fade) also fail the gate.
key_finding.verification: 22-month walk-forward with daily-bar symbol discovery (15 symbols per window). 70/30 train/holdout split. Slippage sensitivity at 0/2/5/10 bps.
